description: This file defines the I18NLangString class, which represents internationalization language strings in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for id, unitId, group, value, note, version, and associated translations, following ORM (Doctrine) annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: I18NLangString
classes.description: Entity class representing language strings for internationalization, with ORM annotations for database mapping, including properties for id, unitId, group, value, note, version, and translations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the language string.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the language string.

methods.name: getUnitId
methods.description: Returns the unit identifier for the language string.

methods.name: setUnitId
methods.description: Sets the unit identifier for the language string.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the associated I18NGroup entity, if any.

methods.name: setGroup
methods.description: Associates an I18NGroup entity with this language string.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the actual language string value.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the optional note for the language string.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the optional note for the language string.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string, if any.
